span.p:
Persistent schedule
Due time · timezone · recurrence

span.p:
Role policy
Enabled · channel · triggers · content scope
Quiet hours · frequency · confirmation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Recheck current memory and schedule
Canceled? Completed? Expired? Scope changed?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Stop the delivery
Canceled only if nothing can have been sent

span.p:
Claim: lease and claim id
Nothing has gone on the network yet

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Dispatch: recheck generation and eligibility
One guarded update to sending, with the frozen body

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Authenticated host callback / webhook
No transaction open · Idempotency-Key = delivery id

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Settle, fenced by that dispatch's claim id
2xx accepted · 4xx refused · anything else unknown

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Declared idempotent channel
and a verified contract?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Bounded retry
Same frozen bytes, same Idempotency-Key

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Delivery uncertain
Reconciliation required before resending

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Complete or schedule the next occurrence

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Proactive contact draft
Own channel, no schedule

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Draft persisted
Bubbles and their frozen ids

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
One review of the whole group
Before its first bubble is exposed

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cancel every bubble never exposed
One reason kept on the batch

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Reason stays visible · doubling wait
Bounded tries, then refused

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Freeze bodies and references
Cut at the channel limit
What no cut fits goes whole, as one file

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Send fragment by fragment
Each an ordinary journal entry with its own frozen id

display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Bubble accepted with its platform message id

The rest of the group goes on
